title.es: Enviar un mensaje claro de coordinación

es: Resolver una coordinación sin calcos literales.
Integrar decisión, investigación, notas, plazo y seguimiento en 80–110 palabras.

teaching.en: Coordinate by naming every person, action and time.
teaching.es: Coordina nombrando cada persona, acción y momento.
teaching.audioText: Coordinate by naming every person, action and time.

teaching.en: Make a decision records the group's choice.
teaching.es: Make a decision registra la elección del grupo.
teaching.explanationEs: La collocation sustituye el calco do a decision.
teaching.audioText: Make a decision records the group's choice.

teaching.en: Do research and take notes support the next action.
teaching.es: Do research y take notes apoyan la siguiente acción.
teaching.explanationEs: Investigación y notas deben tener responsables.
teaching.audioText: Do research and take notes support the next action.

teaching.en: Meet the deadline states when the work must finish.
teaching.es: Meet the deadline indica cuándo debe terminar el trabajo.
teaching.explanationEs: El plazo se conserva de forma exacta.
teaching.audioText: Meet the deadline states when the work must finish.

teaching.en: A concise follow-up confirms what happens next.
teaching.es: Un seguimiento conciso confirma qué ocurre después.
teaching.explanationEs: El cierre asigna una acción concreta.
teaching.audioText: A concise follow-up confirms what happens next.

teaching.en: The workshop draft used do a decision, take research, make notes and make a deadline. Here is the edited message. Team, please make a decision about the venue today. Nia will do research on transport costs by Monday. Leo will take notes during Tuesday's planning call. We must meet the booking deadline on Friday. After the call, Sam will send a follow-up email with Leo's notes and the selected venue. This concise version keeps every person, action and time, corrects all four literal combinations and gives the workshop team a complete plan.

prompt.es: Resuelve en 80–110 palabras la coordinación de una exposición.

answer.text: Team, we need to make a decision about the exhibition layout today. Arun will do research on printing costs before Wednesday and share the figures. Bia will take notes during Thursday's meeting so every change is recorded. We must meet the final proposal deadline at three on Friday. After the meeting, Clara will send a follow-up message with Bia's notes and the chosen layout. Please keep these responsibilities and times unchanged. This clear plan covers the decision, research, notes, deadline and required follow-up for the community exhibition.
accepted: Team, we need to make a decision about the exhibition layout today. Arun will do research on printing costs before Wednesday and share the figures. Bia will take notes during Thursday's meeting so every change is recorded. We must meet the final proposal deadline at three on Friday. After the meeting, Clara will send a follow-up message with Bia's notes and the chosen layout. Please keep these responsibilities and times unchanged. This clear plan covers the decision, research, notes, deadline and required follow-up for the community exhibition.

Please make a decision on the exhibition layout today. Before Wednesday, Arun will do research on printing costs and report the figures. Bia will take notes at the Thursday meeting to record each change. The group must meet the proposal deadline at three on Friday. Clara will send the follow-up after the meeting, including the notes and final layout. This concise coordination message keeps every person, action and time from the brief while using the four target collocations naturally and clearly.

feedback.es: Las variantes integran cuatro collocations y todos los datos de coordinación.

origin.text: Exposición comunitaria: decidir diseño hoy; Arun investiga costes de impresión antes del miércoles y comparte cifras; Bia toma notas en reunión del jueves; propuesta final vence viernes a las 15:00; Clara envía seguimiento con notas y diseño después. Borrador literal: do a decision, make research, do notes, take the deadline.

prompt.es: Recupera en 80–110 palabras una coordinación de estudio.

answer.text: Study group, we will make a decision about the project topic on Monday. Mei will do research on suitable sources on Tuesday and share her list. Jon will take notes during Wednesday's interview so the evidence is recorded. We must meet the draft deadline at noon on Friday. After the draft is complete, Sara will upload the file and send a follow-up message with the link. This plan keeps every responsibility, day and action clear while using the four target collocations naturally in one concise update.

After the draft is complete, Sara will upload the file and send a follow-up message with the link. This plan keeps every responsibility, day and action clear while using the four target collocations naturally in one concise update.

Please make a decision on the study topic on Monday. On Tuesday, Mei will do research on sources and share the list. Jon will take notes in Wednesday's interview to preserve its evidence. The team must meet the draft deadline at noon on Friday. Sara will then upload the file and send the follow-up with its link. This concise message includes all people, dates and actions from the brief, and it uses decision, research, notes and deadline collocations naturally for clear coordination.

feedback.es: La recuperación demuestra los cinco conceptos en un escenario de estudio distinto.

origin.text: Proyecto de estudio: decidir tema el lunes; Mei investiga fuentes el martes y comparte lista; Jon toma notas en entrevista del miércoles; borrador vence viernes al mediodía; Sara sube archivo y envía seguimiento con enlace después. Borrador literal: take a decision, make research, make notes, do the deadline.
